SEARCH & ANSWER VISIBILITY

Be easy to find.
Worth discovering.

A useful website answers the questions your customers actually ask. We make those answers clear, accessible and technically understandable.

Discuss your visibility goals
01 / SEO

Search engine
optimization.

Help search engines discover and understand your pages. The foundation includes crawlable content, page titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, internal links, a sitemap and a fast, accessible experience.

02 / AEO

Answer engine
optimization.

Write direct, useful answers to customer questions. Organize service details, FAQs, costs and processes so readers can understand an answer without piecing it together across the site.

03 / GEO

Generative engine
optimization.

Make the business and its expertise clear in content that generative search systems may retrieve or cite. Accurate claims, specific explanations and consistent entity information matter. Here GEO means generative discovery; local geographic SEO is a separate activity.

04 / AIO

A broader AI
visibility approach.

We use AIO as an umbrella term for making content useful and understandable in AI-assisted discovery. It is not a separate Google certification or a shortcut that guarantees inclusion in an AI answer.

PRACTICAL, NOT MYSTERIOUS

For a hotel,
start with the guest.

Can a visitor quickly understand the rooms, location, check-in times, parking, cancellation policy and how to make a booking?

We would organize those details into helpful pages, connect related information, validate relevant structured data, check indexing and measure the enquiries the site receives.

WHAT THE WORK CAN INCLUDE

Audit the foundation.

Review technical issues, page structure, navigation and the questions your content leaves unanswered.

Improve the content.

Create clear service explanations and genuinely useful answers, supported by accurate business details and appropriate structured data.

Measure and refine.

With authorized access, review indexing, search queries, impressions, clicks and enquiries. Use the evidence to choose the next improvement.

No first-page or AI-citation guarantees.

Google states that its existing SEO best practices apply to its AI search features; no additional special optimization requirements are necessary. Eligibility does not guarantee inclusion.

body:
Skip to content
I.ILYVANTADIGITAL
Selected workExpertiseThe studioContact us
PRIVACY

A clear approach
to your information.

Last updated: 7 October 2026

Project enquiries

When online sending is enabled, the form submits your name, email, selected service and message to our server, which passes it to our email delivery provider to send to ilyvantadigital@gmail.com. We use your enquiry to respond about your project. The form reports an error if delivery is unavailable; it does not silently switch to sending through your email app.

Interactive sample workspaces

Demo data is stored on the server in a workspace associated with your signed-in identity or a random, secure browser session cookie. The browser session cookie expires after seven days. Reset replaces the selected project’s sample data. Request counters are used to limit contact-form misuse. It is separate from other visitors’ workspaces. Use fictional details only. The reset control replaces the chosen project’s demo data with its sample starting state. Contact rate-limit counters are also stored to limit misuse.

Browser preferences

The motion setting is saved in your browser so your preference can be remembered. This site does not include an advertising tracker or an analytics integration.

Hosting and external services

The hosting provider may process technical request information to operate the website. Links to WhatsApp, LinkedIn, GitHub and email services are subject to those services’ own policies. Some hosting environments may require you to sign in to view the website.

Contact

For questions about information you have shared with us, email ilyvantadigital@gmail.com. Please do not send patient records, account passwords or other sensitive information through an initial enquiry.
